image_title: Consolidated Financial Data - Third Quarter, Fiscal 2026
summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of Fiscal 2026, detailing both reported IFRS and adjusted non-IFRS financial measures. Key metrics include operating profit, net profit, and earnings per share (EPS) for the periods ending December 31, 2025, and December 31, 2024. The data shows a reported operating profit of $3,030 million for the nine months ended December 31, 2025, with an adjusted non-IFRS figure of $3,173 million. For the three months ended December 31, 2025, revenues reached ₹45,479 crore, reflecting an 8.9% year-over-year growth. The document also highlights significant changes in operating expenses and profit before income taxes, indicating trends in financial performance and operational efficiency.
